articles.title: U.S. Justice Department assembles force to shield against foreign AI threats
articles.snippet: The new DOJ task force will aid the recently designated U.S. "SI Force" by warding off bad actors backed by other nations, criminal groups or corporate fraud.

articles.title: Bitcion tumbles to $76,000 as collapsing AI trade drags stocks sharply lower
articles.snippet: The post-election rally quickly reversed as AI stocks plunged, but cryptocurrencies held up relatively better despite a $1 billion liquidation wave.

articles.title: Standard Chartered and SBI back crypto insurer Soter as funding reaches $23.5 million
articles.snippet: Soter also received backing of 500 BTC and 2000 ETH, worth another $43 million at current prices.

articles.title: Crypto for Advisors: Where investors stake crypto shapes how much of the reward they keep
Gate CEO says crypto exchanges must prove they can survive a hack like Binance’s
articles.snippet: Lin Han says Gate holds enough assets in cold storage to cover customer balances even if its hot wallets are emptied. An independent audit is underway.
